what: Stage 2B frozen bridge (design §5.3; amendments A1-A6; plan step 7)

integrator.method: fixed-step RK4, inputs held per step (flybrain/rate_stepper.py)

body.model: FlyGym 2.1 FlyBody, TetheredWorld, legs in air (A1.2)
body.R1_torque: not calibrated here (robustness arm; separate frozen file when run)

bridge_scheme: command_j = offset_j + agonist_angle_sign_j * scale_j * (u_j - c_j) / s_j, clipped to the joint range (organism/mn_joint_bridge.py)

sensory.hair_plate_note: no verified source at freeze: all four combinations are run and reported, none primary (A1.5)

R2_r_star_hz.note: amendment A5: upper value 150 Hz; the design's 200 Hz equals the nominal rate cap, where g_c diverges

conditions.deafferented: body moves, no afferent input (bit-identical to open loop, A1.4)
conditions.closed_loop: each leg's afferents read that leg
conditions.scrambled: multivariate Fourier phase randomisation of this replicate's closed-loop body state, every tick; rng = numpy.default_rng([seed, replicate, 0x5C]); angles clipped to joint ranges

drive_stats.centring: median drive of every channel (amendment A5)
